name: כפל שברים אלגבריים – צמצום הגורם (x−y) וחזקות (באנגלית)

functions.name: igcd2
functions.body: if q=0 then abs(p) else igcd2(q,mod(p,q))

questiontext:
Simplify the following:

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}}. \]

Leave your answer as a single fraction in its simplest terms.

= [[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Multiply, cancel the common bracket, then simplify the powers of the same base and the numbers.
Step 1 — Multiply numerators and denominators
When multiplying algebraic fractions use the same method as for normal fractions. Multiply the numerators and the denominators together to get the numerator and denominator of the answer:

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}} = \frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}} \]

Step 2 — Cancel the common bracket
The bracket \(\left(x-y\right)\) is a factor of the top and of the bottom, so it cancels (we assume \(x\neq y\)):

\[ \frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}=\frac{{{CT:4}}}{{{CT:5}}} \]

Step 3 — Powers of x and the numbers
Use \(\frac{a^m}{a^n}=a^{m-n}\): [[if test="{{CT:14}}"]]\(\frac{x^{{CT:6}}}{x^{{CT:7}}}=x^{{CT:8}}\) (the power of \(x\) stays in the numerator).[[elif test="{{CT:15}}"]]\(\frac{x^{{CT:6}}}{x^{{CT:7}}}=\frac{1}{x^{{CT:9}}}\) (the power of \(x\) stays in the denominator).[[else]]\(\frac{x^{{CT:6}}}{x^{{CT:7}}}=1\) (the powers are equal).[[/if]] [[if test="{{CT:16}}"]]The coefficients have the common factor \(\gcd({{CT:10}},{{CT:11}})={{CT:12}}\), which cancels.[[else]]The coefficients \({{CT:10}}\) and \({{CT:11}}\) have no common factor to cancel.[[/if]] Be sure to reduce the fraction to its lowest terms. In this example:

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}} = \frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}} = {{CT:13}}. \]

on_true.feedback: Your answer is algebraically equivalent to the correct answer but is not in its simplest form.
